2. Short facts are that on 21.092006, the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.303 of 2006 in the Sixth Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Dhaka, impleading opposite parties as defendants for declaration that the exparte judgment and decree dated 10.11.2004; passed in Title Suit No.267 of 2003 is illegal, inoperative, collusive and not binding upon them. 

 9. On going to the materials on record, it transpires that plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.303 of 2006, challenging the exparte decree dated 10.11.2004 passed in Title Suit No.267 of 2003. After considering the merit of the application the learned Judge of Trial Court stayed the Title Execution Case No.01 of 2005 on contest. Against which Civil Revision is pending before District Judge. 

 11. It is admitted facts that plaintiffs are in possession in the suit land. If the Title Execution Case No.01 of 2005 arose out of exparte decree dated 10.11.2004 of Title Suit No.267 of 2003 is allowed to continue, then certainly the plaintiffs will be evicted from suit premises, therefore the purpose of the suit and revision before District Judge will be frustrated.
